cards.claim: Ronald Powell is associated with football.
cards.quote: a High School All-American by "USA Today", "Parade", and EA Sports. He was selected to play in the 2010 U.S. Army All-American Bowl, where he was voted MVP. Regarded as a five-star college recruit by Rivals.com, Powell was listed as the No. 1 prospect (regardless of position) in the class of 2010. Powell accepted an athletic scholarship to attend the University of Florida in Gainesville, Florida, where he was a member of coach Urban Meyer and coach Will Muschamp's Florida Gators football teams from 2010 to 2013.

cards.claim: Ronald Powell is associated with football.
cards.quote: He spent three seasons at Florida from 2010 to 2013 , playing in 53 games with 79 total tackles , 18.5 tackles for loss and 11 sacks . He declared for the draft in 2014 after the conclusion of his junior season . `` We 're very saddened to learn about the passing of former Gators player Ronald Powell . Our thoughts and prayers are with his family and loved ones , '' the school said via the Florida Gators Football account on X .

cards.claim: Ronald Powell is associated with football.
cards.quote: In his sophomore year , he became a regular starter for the Gators , playing and starting in 12 games . In an injury-plagued junior year , he tore his left ACL two different times , first in the spring Orange and Blue game , and again during rehabilitation . For the 2012 season , he earned a medical redshirt . In 2013 , Powell played in 11 games and started in eight .
